purpose: Teach: 放浪/分断/改憲/直撃/哀れ/中高年/棄却/斬り

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、放浪型の患者さんを医療チームでサポートしております
lines.en: Ren, we support wandering patients with our entire medical team.
lines.style: Clinical but not cold. Clear diction on each phrase. Warm undertone beneath the professionalism. Patient cadence, as if explaining something important to someone worth explaining it to.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、家族の分断による心の傷を医療チームで丁寧に診ます
lines.en: Yes, we examine the emotional wounds from family separation carefully as a team.
lines.style: Steady, measured delivery. Slight pause after "Yes" — choosing words with care. Warm but professional. The tone of someone who has sat with this kind of pain before.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療政策の改憲には貴院、関心を持っていらっしゃるんですね、先生
lines.en: So the hospital takes an interest in medical policy reform, don't you, doctor?
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly tentative. Genuine curiosity — not challenging, observing. Soft attack on the opening. A young person testing whether an older professional will engage on bigger ideas.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、台風直撃時の救急対応を医療チームで訓練しております
lines.en: Yes, we train our emergency response team for typhoon conditions.
lines.style: Direct and factual, but not detached. Slight emphasis on "train" — showing preparation and commitment. Calm, steady tempo. The voice of someone who has thought through contingencies.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 哀れな状況の患者さんへ、貴院、丁寧に向き合われますね、先生
lines.en: You face patients in difficult circumstances with real care, don't you, doctor?
lines.style: Gentle, reflective tone. Quiet respect underneath. No challenge in the voice — genuine observation. Slightly slower pace, as if turning something over. A moment of recognition.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、中高年の生活習慣病を医療チームで指導しております
lines.en: Yes, we guide our patients on lifestyle disease management across middle age.
lines.style: Patient, clear. The tone of someone used to repeating important information without impatience. Warm specificity — not abstract, but about real people and real guidance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療裁判の棄却事例を、貴院、参考になさったんですね、先生
lines.en: The hospital learned from court dismissals in medical cases, I imagine, doctor?
lines.style: Careful, almost delicate phrasing. Searching for understanding rather than making an accusation. Quiet, respectful tempo. The voice of someone asking what adults know that he doesn't yet.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、武術の斬り合い式の稽古を医療チームで負傷時にサポートしました
lines.en: Yes, we supported our team when they treated injuries from martial arts training sessions.
lines.style: Clear, composed delivery. Slight warmth on "supported" — showing care for the team. Measured pace, professional but not distant. The tone of someone accounting for real responsibility.
